title: identify_language output
description: A spoken-language identification for the recording. Probabilities are averaged over the listened windows and folded to canonical language codes; they are decision scores, not calibrated probabilities, and the model makes no claim about audio it was not trained on.

language.description: The most likely canonical language code (ISO 639-1/639-3 style, as listed in languages.json). A yue prediction is reported as zh because the two model labels are folded together.

confidence.description: The probability of the reported language after averaging across the listened windows and folding aliases; equal to candidates[0].probability.

isReliable.description: True when the top-two margin is at least 0.25 after folding, and the top language is not Norwegian, Swedish or Danish. Those three are always reported as unreliable because the model confuses them.

candidates.description: Up to five languages, sorted by folded probability descending (ties by language code ascending), the winner first.

probability.description: The folded probability for this language.

windows.description: The integer number of 30 second windows actually listened to. 1 for recordings of 30 seconds or less (zero padded); otherwise min(requested, available), spread across the recording.
